channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: US Plans Mandatory Social Media Checks for All Visitors Under New Security Proposal
item.description: The US has proposed mandatory disclosure of five years of social media history from all incoming travellers, including those from visa-free countries, as part of a major digital security expansion.

item.title: People of Purpose: Asim Khan’s Immersive On-Ground Journey and His Leadership in Driving Change Through CSR at Cadence
item.description: Mohammad Asim Khan, from Kanpur's roots to Cadence CSR lead, lives with farmers to end stubble burning while reforming India's CSR for deeper, unbiased impact.

item.title: Indian Rupee Hits Historic 90.47 Low vs USD on Dec 11 Amid US Tariffs, Capital Exit, Worst Fall Since 2022
item.description: Indian rupee hits record low of 90.47 vs USD on Dec 11, down 0.5% amid US tariffs and foreign investment flight worst annual drop since 2022.

item.title: Pilot Crunch & Tech Glitches: IndiGo’s Offers Rs 10,000 Vouchers Amid 4,500-Flight Chaos
item.description: IndiGo compensates severely affected passengers with Rs 10,000 vouchers following over 4,500 cancellations due to pilot shortages and technical issues from December 2-9, 2025.

item.title: SC Declares Acid Attackers ‘Threat to Society’: Iron Hand, Attempt to Murder Charges in Landmark Push
item.description: The Supreme Court proposes trying acid attack perpetrators for attempt to murder with life terms, fast-tracks cases, and pushes for better victim protections amid low convictions and survivor pleas.

item.title: Veteran Congress Leader and Former Home Minister Shivraj Patil Passes Away at Age 90
item.description: The death of former Union Home Minister Shivraj Patil marks the end of a four-decade career in public service.

item.title: Austria Passes Nationwide Ban on Headscarves for Girls Under 14; Critics Call the Move Discriminatory
item.description: Austria's parliament has enacted a nationwide school headscarf ban for girls under 14, imposing fines up to €800 on non-compliant parents while igniting fierce debates on integration, secularism, and discrimination.

item.title: Karnataka Sees 17 Lakh Drop in Government School Enrolment Over 15 Years, Says Education Minister
item.description: Karnataka sees 17 lakh drop in government school enrolment over 15 years, says Minister. Read more here.

item.title: Delhi High Court Cuts Wife’s Maintenance from ₹25,000 to ₹17,000, Citing Husband’s Limited ₹5.18 Lakh Annual Income
item.description: Delhi High Court reduces a wife's ₹25,000 monthly maintenance to ₹17,000, deeming it excessive based on the husband's ₹5.18 lakh annual income from 2018-19 ITR, applying a fair income-sharing principle.

item.title: IndiGo Crisis Deepens: DGCA Sacks Four Inspectors, Summons CEO as Flight Chaos Continues
item.description: India’s aviation regulator has removed four inspectors and launched strict oversight after IndiGo’s pilot shortages and new duty rules triggered unprecedented nationwide flight disruptions.
